name: Trap Lore
body:
By studying traps you have become better able to spot and avoid them.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Knowledge (dungeoneering) 7 ranks, secret knowledge of avoidance (loremaster secret), 3rd-level loremaster

Benefit: Whenever you would make a Perception check to notice a trap, you can use Knowledge (dungeoneering) to notice the trap instead. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus per three levels of loremaster you possess to Reflex saves made to avoid traps and Armor Class against attacks made by traps.

Normal: Normally traps are spotted using the Perception skill.
